worldcombat.skill.axekick.summary: A short step into a raised-leg chop: the heel drives straight down a fixed narrow band in front, dealing damage and possibly dazing the target; an empty band drives the heel into the ground and hurts the user.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.0: The falling heel deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type match-up and crits are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.1: Raise the leg %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, chopping down at %3$s blocks per tick, after stepping %4$s blocks toward the aim.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.2: The band in front reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s block half-width; the leg hangs %3$s ticks before the chop falls; an empty band costs %4$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.3: On a successful hit there is a %1$s chance to daze the target for %2$s ticks and shove it %3$s blocks outward; while dazed each action has a %4$s chance to fumble, and whenever it damages a non-ally it takes recoil of about 2%%–12.5%% of its own maximum health, heavier with its Attack.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.description.ai: Aim any direction or world point; the direction locks on commit and never curves back to the original target. The band is pinned to one spot in front, so a target that steps aside can slip it and blocks cut the leg path; an empty chop still pays its recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.high.on: High chop: a higher leg raise, a faster chop, x1.08 chop power and a wider band, at a longer wind-up, a longer cooldown, 0.3 blocks less reach, a shorter step, a longer hang before the chop and a heavier self-hurt on a miss.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.high.off: Low quick chop: faster to fire, farther, a longer step, a shorter hang and a lighter self-hurt on a miss, at the cost of lower chop power and a narrower band.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the chop power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the chop power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.0: Chop through a hard target with a straight-down strike
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.1: Daze a target that just moved or boosted
worldcombat.skill.axekick.use.2: Finish in your face with the lightest self-hurt of the family
worldcombat.skill.axekick.preference.hig: On: a higher leg raise, a faster chop, x1.08 chop power and a wider band, at +2 ticks of wind-up, +4 ticks of cooldown, 0.3 blocks less reach, a shorter step, a longer hang before the chop and +0.03 self-hurt on a miss. Off: a low quick chop, faster, farther, a longer step and lighter on a miss, but weaker and narrower.
Only chop a target within this distance; closer in otherwise. Larger starts sooner, and whiffs more often.
On: do not Axe Kick a target that is already dazed; off: chop anyway as plain damage.
